# File Grid

Contents of a File Grid field are accessed just as a regular Grid field would be, [refer to the Grid field documentation for a full reference](./grid.md). A notable difference is the default File column automatically has a short name of `file`:

:::note
The following examples use a field named `files_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{% for row in entry.files_field %}
    {{ row.file.filename }}
{% endfor %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
@foreach($entry->files_field as $row)
    {{ $row->file->filename }}
@endforeach
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>


:::info
See the ExpressionEngine Documentation for more information on the [File Grid fieldtype](https://docs.expressionengine.com/latest/fieldtypes/file-grid.html)
:::
